question: What ten-syllabled Tārā knowledge is the speaker about to transmit to the beloved disciple?
premises: The speaker directly addresses the beloved disciple and commands attention.
The speaker explicitly declares the intention to speak.
The object of transmission is identified as the ten-syllabled Tārā knowledge.
inference: The verse introduces the imminent transmission of the ten-syllabled Tārāvidyā to the disciple.
plain_english: Hear that, beloved; I speak to you the ten-syllabled Tārāvidyā.
